verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Draft Mode ([luma-docs-5]) and a cheaper 360p Draft tier priced at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip ([luma-docs-15]). That covers the 'draft fast and cheap' half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a way to take a chosen draft and upscale or re-render it to final resolution while keeping the same take. Missing for 10: a documented upscale or promote-draft-to-final workflow that preserves the chosen take, detail on final resolutions and their costs, and hands-on corroboration of the draft-to-final flow.
